PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (20.0, 16.0, 24.0),          # pair gm/Id [S/A]; high gm/Id lowers Vgs for tail headroom
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),             # pair length [um]
    "Id_pair": (30e-6, 15e-6, 32e-6),       # per-branch current; tail = 2*Id_pair
    "C":       (0.25e-12, 0.1e-12, 0.5e-12),# Sallen-Key capacitor C1 (C2 = C + cgg of pair)
    "gmid_p":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),           # PMOS mirror load gm/Id [S/A]
    "gmid_t":  (20.0, 12.0, 22.0),          # reference/tail mirror gm/Id (L = 1 um)
    "fc_t":    (1.5e6, 1.3e6, 1.7e6),       # Sallen-Key design target frequency [Hz]
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-12)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 1.0)              # DC level of the buffer (vin = vout)
    Id = p["Id_pair"]
    C = p["C"]
    fc_t = p["fc_t"]

    # Estimate the tail node from the pair Vgs, then re-size the pair with body effect
    m1a = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Id, vds=0.85, vsb=0.0)
    v_tail = vcm - m1a.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Id, vds=0.85, vsb=v_tail)

    # Reference (diode-connected, sinks iref) and tail mirror, same L and gm/Id
    ref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], 1.0, iref, vds=0.7)
    tail = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], 1.0, 2 * Id, vds=v_tail)

    # PMOS mirror load: left node at about VDD - Vsg
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], 1.0, Id, vds=0.6)

    # Sallen-Key unity-gain lowpass with C2 = C + cgg of the pair gate
    C2e = C + m1.cgg
    R = 1.0 / (2 * PI * fc_t * math.sqrt(C * C2e))
    Q = 0.5 * math.sqrt(C / C2e)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", ref)     # reference sink (diode-connected)
    n.dev("Mt", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", tail)     # tail source
    # Pair: gate b is the non-inverting gate; gate vout is the feedback gate
    n.dev("M1", "left", "b", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vout", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "left", "left", "vdd", "vdd", m3)        # diode load
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "left", "vdd", "vdd", m3)        # mirror output

    # Sallen-Key network: vin -R1- a -R2- b, C1 from a to vout, C2 from b to vss
    n.R("R1", "vin", "a", R)
    n.R("R2", "a", "b", R)
    n.C("C1", "a", "vout", C)
    n.C("C2", "b", "vss", C)

    x = 10.0
    mag_stop = 1.0 / math.sqrt((1 - x * x) ** 2 + (x / Q) ** 2)
    atten = -db(mag_stop)
    if Q > 1.0 / math.sqrt(2.0):
        peak = db(Q / math.sqrt(1.0 - 1.0 / (4.0 * Q * Q)))
    else:
        peak = 0.0
    i_total = iref + 2 * Id
    pred = {
        "gain_db": db(1.0),
        "fc": fc_t,
        "atten_db": atten,
        "peaking_db": peak,
        "f0": fc_t,
        "q": Q,
        "power": 1.8 * i_total,   # W
    }
    return n, pred
